# apipbx_ivr (Resource)

An IVR menu. Import with "<tenant id>/<id>".



<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `name` (String)
- `tenant_id` (String)

### Optional

- `announcement` (String) Asterisk sound name(s) joined with &, such as custom/welcome; empty plays nothing. Sounds are server-wide.
- `direct_dial` (Set of String) Numbers a caller may dial instead of keying an entry: extension and/or conference. A key of the menu wins over a number that starts the same; a number shorter than the longest choice waits for a 3 second pause.
- `entries` (Attributes List) Keys of the menu (at most 12). (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--entries))
- `invalid_id` (String)
- `invalid_type` (String) Where unknown keys lead after the retries: extension, ring_group, voicemail, time_condition, ivr, queue, conference, announcement, misc_destination, set_caller_id, paging_group, voicemail_group, disa or hangup.
- `max_retries` (Number) Unknown keys, and silences, allowed before giving up (1-10).
- `recording_id` (String) Id of an apipbx_recording to play instead of the announcement.
- `timeout_id` (String)
- `timeout_seconds` (Number) Seconds to wait for a key (1-60).
- `timeout_type` (String) Where silence leads after the retries: extension, ring_group, voicemail, time_condition, ivr, queue, conference, announcement, misc_destination, set_caller_id, paging_group, voicemail_group, disa or hangup.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) The ID of this resource.

<a id="nestedatt--entries"></a>
### Nested Schema for `entries`

Required:

- `destination_type` (String) extension, ring_group, voicemail, time_condition, ivr, queue, conference, announcement, misc_destination, set_caller_id, paging_group, voicemail_group, disa or hangup.
- `digit` (String) One to six of the digits 0-9 and *.

Optional:

- `destination_id` (String) Id of that destination (not for hangup).
